title: Clay Relationship Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clay:relationship
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(network_segment) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Clay relationship events land each day and how many distinct network segment values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Clay relationship records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct network segment values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Clay relationship activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
